title: Enlightened Client
description: A simple NeoForge 1.21.1 client that contains new content but is mostly vanilla
body:
What it adds:

Biomes O’ Plenty: for a bunch of new biomes—fresh sights, still vanilla-friendly.

Terralith: reshapes mountains, valleys, and cave layouts for more interesting exploration routes.

Sophisticated Backpacks: for upgradable portable storage—filters, pickup rules, crafting upgrade, and more.

Why download:
Exploration actually feels new (biomes + terrain) and you won’t run out of inventory mid-adventure (backpacks). Clean, (maybe :D) lightweight, no wild overhauls.

Need-to-know:
MC 1.21.1 • NeoForge • Client & Server • built for Enlightened SMP.

(if you need modpack help or would like to report issues msg/friend "ken._.carsonn" on discord)
